pr_title: Keep AI Studio responsive during ACP startup
pr_body:
## Summary

First implementation slice for the AI Studio ACP startup responsiveness fix:
- add configured-route resolution that does not require synchronous runtime discovery
- separate Agent Host binding preparation from ACP session attachment
- keep existing synchronous compatibility entry points temporarily while AI Studio is migrated in the following slice

The final branch will add the background startup worker, Ask/Build polling, cancellation, regression tests, and visual validation before completion.
